Overview

Kolding is a city in Southern Denmark with a population of 60,000. A port city on the Kolding Fjord, known for its 13th-century Koldinghus castle and design school. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
